/* SQL_ID: AV.AssetValuation.selectList */ SELECT v.VALUATION_ID AS valuationId, v.EVAL_DATE AS evalDate, v.PRODUCT_CODE AS productCode, v.VALUATION_AMT AS valuationAmt, v.CURRENCY_CODE AS currencyCode, v.USE_YN AS useYn, v.REG_DTM AS regDtm, v.UPD_DTM AS updDtm FROM AV_ASSET_VALUATION v
ORDER BY v.UPD_DTM DESC, v.VALUATION_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
